## About
Aqua Dental is Dr. Chitra Pradeep's practice on E 32nd St in Austin. Some of our patients have been coming here for many years, and a few bring their whole family.
Patients tell us the office feels spotless and calm, and that everyone from the front desk to the hygienists remembers them. Dr. Pradeep works slowly and carefully, and she likes to explain what she sees so you understand your own dental and gum health.
We're rated 4.8 on Google from 326 reviews, and many of those come from people who used to dread the dentist.

## Services
- Teeth cleaning: Regular cleaning to keep your teeth and gums healthy, done with a careful, gentle touch.
- Fillings: Fillings to repair teeth, with time taken to explain what's needed and why.
- Teeth whitening: Whitening for patients who want a brighter smile.

## FAQ
Q: I get nervous about the dentist. Is this a good fit for me?
A: Several reviewers say they were anxious about dental visits and found Dr. Pradeep and the team careful and thoughtful. We go at your pace.

Q: Do you see whole families?
A: Yes. Some of our patients have been bringing their families to Dr. Pradeep for years.

Q: What days are you open?
A: We see patients Monday through Thursday. The office is closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
